title: Win the Piece Back
setup: You are a piece down. Your rook stares down the a-file at the bishop on a5, which is defended only by the knight on c6.
hint: The bishop on a5 has one defender. Before you take the bishop, ask what can take the defender.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nxc6}} removes the only piece covering a5. After {{bxc6}}, {{Rxa5}} takes the bishop: knight for knight, then a bishop for nothing, and the material is level again. Anything slower lets {{Bxb4}} trade off your knight, and Black stays a piece up.

The defender is often cheaper than the piece it guards.
